meta.source: Maine Dispensary Guide — town-cluster hub registry
meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the 5 town-cluster hub pages. Both /find-a-dispensary and the 5 hub pages consume this file so the region/town lists never drift.
meta.methodology: Cluster definitions are the same 5 guideRegions[] in apps/maine-cannabis/src/pages/find-a-dispensary.astro. Each cluster carries its full guides[] list (deduped within cluster) so hub pages can render their town directory without re-parsing find-a-dispensary.
